//: Optional sanity check (`npm run typecheck` / `make typecheck`). The build itself needs no toolchain.
//strictness: src/*.ts is deliberately written in the TypeScript SUBSET that tools/striptypes.mjs can strip
with zero dependencies (see CONTRIBUTING.md). That subset excludes function-type annotations
and several generic forms, so full `strict` is not reachable by design. What IS enforced here
is everything that catches real bugs in this codebase: unknown properties, bad arity, wrong
types where they are declared, and unreachable/uncallable code.
